task.notes: Tries E23a and E23b, new1: t = 0.8.

floor.what: the organisers' floor: the reference's 10% working copy (copy_last or wt_identity)

fgw.what: displacement interpolation between the brackets (fused Gromov-Wasserstein coupling, proper rotation, McCann moves) with a mixture of real cells of both, scaled to the embryo size rule

fgw_partial.what: fgw with a partial FGW coupling (POT's partial_fused_gromov_wasserstein on the entry's costs and alpha, uniform masses) transporting the share s, the overlap of the brackets' anchors' celltype distributions; an anchor with no mass does not move; the entry's coupling where s is exactly 1
fgw_partial.label: celltype
choices_on_no_record: the overlap as the estimate of the share
the zero displacement of an unmatched anchor

fgw_damp.what: fgw with every anchor's displacement, of both brackets, multiplied by s, the overlap of the brackets' anchors' celltype distributions (fgw_partial's share); the entry's balanced coupling, partners and rotation
fgw_damp.label: celltype

fgw_part_rand.what: fgw with a uniformly random subset of round(s x its anchors) anchors of each bracket keeping the entry's displacement and the others still, s fgw_partial's share; the entry's balanced coupling, partners and rotation
fgw_part_rand.label: celltype

fgw_still.what: fgw with every anchor's displacement 0: each bracket's cells at their own normalised positions, the later bracket's rotated into the earlier's frame by the entry's rotation

fgw_damp_m.what: fgw with every anchor's displacement of a bracket multiplied by one factor of that bracket: the mean over the bracket's cells of the norm of the k-anchor mean displacement under fgw_partial's coupling on the same anchors, over the entry's; the entry's balanced coupling, directions, partners and rotation
fgw_damp_m.label: celltype
